body.name: allocation-guided exploration and interval handle
body.construction: Use the primal--dual programs \(\mathcal B(w)\) and \(\mathcal D(w)\) to select arm-specific cell quotas at the implicit level \(w_n\) with \(n=T\); realize those quotas through predictable dyadic exploration that prices each pull by an upper confidence bound for \(|\tau_P|\), and feed the realized local counts into polynomial approximation for the positive-part term plus a bias-aware augmented score for the benchmark term and one connected interval.
